newsitem.title: UK: Tom Hanks confesses directing was "brutal".
newsitem.headline: Tom Hanks confesses directing was "brutal".

text.p: Dual Oscar-winning actor Tom Hanks on Thursday confessed that directing his first Hollywood film was brutal and exhausting.
Hanks, in London for the premiere of "That Thing You Do," told reporters: "I hardly got any sleep or exercise and ate bad food.

"It was brutal. I was exhausted at the end of filming. As soon as you open the film production office four months before filming starts, you are managing a crisis 18 hours a day. You can't shirk a single duty," he said.

Hanks, who also wrote the screenplay and plays a music executive who manages a band, said: "After we finished I went on a vacation with my family and woke from time to time to introduce myself to my kids. "Hello, I'm your father ... now I'm going back to bed'."
